title: 8th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/8/1/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the no-confidence motion against Minister of Homeland Security and Technology Ali Ihusaan, submitted under Constitution Article 101(a) and Article 229(a) of the Majlis Rules of Procedure.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Courts Act (Law No. 22/2010), submitted by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to take up the no-confidence motion against Homeland Security Minister Ali Ihusaan and begin debate on a bill amending the Courts Act.
